en: Black-and-white postcard showing a grand historic theatre building in an urban setting, with elaborate neo-baroque architecture, twin towers topped by statues, and a large arched entrance. Trees, gardens and a street with vehicles appear in the foreground. Printed caption at the top left reads "CLUJ – Teatrul National", and above the main entrance the inscription "TEATRUL NATIONAL" is visible.
